customer_relations.label: Customer Relations
customer_relations.headline: Customer Relations Professional
customer_relations.objective: Customer relationship professional with experience in banking, customer service, onboarding, sales support, and recovery operations. Focused on listening carefully, communicating clearly, and following through to build dependable customer relationships.

experience.title: Relationship Officer
bullets: Responded to customer enquiries in person and by phone.
Identified relevant cross-selling and upselling opportunities.
Worked with sales and marketing teams on customer acquisition and retention.

experience.title: DMA (Recovery Department)
bullets: Followed up with customers about repayments by phone and message.
Discussed repayment options and negotiated next steps with customers.
Visited customers in person as part of recovery follow-up.
Coordinated recovery cases with teammates and branches.

achievements: Retained clients by understanding their needs, addressing concerns proactively, and offering solutions.
Partnered with sales colleagues to support customer acquisition and team targets.
Contributed to strong customer satisfaction through attentive service.
